notes.title: Get Ready to be Terrified with JANITOR BLEEDS: The Retro-Inspired Horror Game
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000613/ac503d24a4e680e619d08242289a2edb9711c7fd.png[/img]

Step into the dark, twisted world of JANITOR BLEEDS, the retro-inspired horror game that will keep you on the edge of your seat. And now, for a limited time, you can experience the terror at 50% off during the Steam Spring Sale!

JANITOR BLEEDS takes place in an old arcade located deep in the dark forest, and you find yourself stranded there after a car crash. As you search for help, a mysterious arcade machine called JANITOR beckons you to play. Little do you know, playing JANITOR unleashes a horrible force upon you, and the only way to survive is to go deeper into the arcade.

But beware, the further you go, the more the events of the arcade game start to influence the real world around you. Your eyes will be glued to the screen as you play, but who knows what's happening right behind your back?

With its retro-inspired graphics and eerie soundtrack, JANITOR BLEEDS is the perfect horror game for fans of the classics. You'll be transported back in time to the golden age of arcades, but with a dark and twisted twist.

The game's unique storyline and gameplay mechanics will keep you engaged and on the edge of your seat. Solve puzzles, dodge obstacles, and fight off terrifying enemies as you make your way through the arcade and try to survive.

JANITOR BLEEDS has received critical acclaim for its immersive gameplay and spine-chilling atmosphere, with reviewers raving about the game's ability to keep them on the edge of their seats.

Don't miss out on this incredible deal! Download JANITOR BLEEDS now at 50% off during the Steam Spring Sale and experience the horror for yourself. But be warned, once you start playing, there's no turning back...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1552310/JANITOR_BLEEDS/

notes.title: Triple Take is a game of the saying “third time’s the charm” – but the third time might just cause some rage quits this time
notes.notes:
Finland biggest publisher Bonus Stage Publishing (That's us, yey) today announced Triple Take: a game by FlyAway found its way to their portfolio. The game will be released in 2022. 

The demo is already available on Steam.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734250

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37611909/cf3eddeeff2922ebb1d02fc717e994d92a883a17.gif[/img]

Triple Take is a series of unexpected experiences in the form of a fast 2D precision platformer where the level evolves as you complete it! Run, wall jump, climb and swim through increasingly difficult levels in (un)vibrantly colored worlds! 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37611909/ba6e8606ffab44e3c9d11140963f44d7e722b7c8.jpg[/img]

When you start any level for the first time, it might seem to be almost too easy to beat, but the levels evolve when you play further. Every time you beat any level, the level changes somehow and you need to play it again. Three times. Triple Take. Ok, you got it. This makes completing levels… difficult. Jumps become more difficult, new threats reveal themselves, and new pathways open up! Difficult.

notes.title: JANITOR BLEEDS is now officially released
notes.notes:
JANITOR BLEEDS is set out to send chills down your neck for weeks — the indie horror game for retro and horror fans is out now!

[previewyoutube=mx11exHp97Q;full]
[/previewyoutube]

JANITOR BLEEDS was featured in the 2021 Haunted Demo Disc and is now being fully published by Bonus Stage Publishing. The shivering horror game is about a haunted arcade where you have to keep on playing JANITOR, the arcade game which bleeds onto your reality. The only way to survive is to keep on playing to keep JANITOR satisfied.

“The horror of JANITOR BLEEDS is based on having to focus on playing the arcade game whilst not knowing what might be happening in the surroundings. When you are playing a horror game, you might not have any idea what is happening behind you when you are focusing on the screen”, describes Elias Massa, the Game Designer of JANITOR BLEEDS.

notes.title: JANITOR BLEEDS release announcement
notes.notes:
Today, Bonus Stage Publishing and Korpus are horrified to announce that JANITOR BLEEDS will be launching on PC and consoles in early 2022!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000613/79ac0857245a8a26380db3e6570d72d6a17c20a2.png[/img]

Step into the world of an abandoned amusement arcade and find JANITOR, an old arcade game mysteriously inviting you to look deeper and deeper into itself. Suddenly JANITOR starts to take control of your life and the whole world, and the only way for you to survive is to find some more coins to keep playing it.

Or is it JANITOR, who is playing you? You must remember the evil force is in the game, and also slowly creeping into the real world, so you will never know what's behind your back right now...

----


The game is being published by Bonus Stage Publishing and it will come out on PC (Windows, Linux, macOS), Nintendo Switch, Xbox, and PlayStation in 2022. Meanwhile waiting for the full game to be released, JANITOR BLEEDS has an open demo on Steam, and an open testing session currently running on the G.Round platform.
